name: app-pearl-glass-finance-dashboard-on-monitor
title: Frosted pearl finance dashboard with fanned cards and hairline bar charts on a monitor
whatItIs: A monitor on a steel stand against grey, showing a translucent light dashboard: a tile sidebar with a black active tile, a fan of frosted payment cards, four stat strips with tiny sparklines, hairline bar and wave charts and a transaction list. Numbers are set in a light serif.
whatItMeans: Refined and quiet; pearl glass and serif figures feel like private banking.
techniques: Fan translucent cards at the top as a hero.
Draw charts with hairline bars and single waves.
Set numerals in a light serif.
Keep a nearly monochrome pearl palette with a black active state.

vocabulary.definition: A chart drawn in very thin lines.
A navigation of square icon tiles.
